name: Ploutoz live-reserve collateral pricing
summary: The DOP collateral oracle valued DOP from live DOP/BUSD pool reserves, so a transient reserve imbalance produced unsupported borrowing power.
notes: PancakeOracle is a direct, non-proxy contract. Its runtime was absent in the preceding block and is byte-identical at deployment and immediately before the incident.

Gross depletion of the six pToken reserves, combined with the protocol controller as one victim union, is 85 CAKE, 18,000 DOLLY, 18 WETH, 1.6 BTCB, 89,000 USDT, and 90,000 BUSD. Receipt transfers and archive balances independently reconcile every component; fee transfers between each pToken and the controller cancel inside the union. The controller retains the 8,450 DOP collateral supplied in the receipt. Flash liquidity, helper withdrawals, and later swaps are financing or disposal of already-counted assets and are excluded. The imported approximately $365,000 estimate is replaced by exact asset depletion and independently preceding CAKE, ETH, and BTC prices. Exact decimal component arithmetic totals $363,406.751246242747830; the JSON number is its nearest IEEE-754 representation.
